children: According to Sina Finance, Iraq's Oil Ministry said the country will soon receive imported gasoline shipments to help fill a domestic supply gap. The ministry cited a statement from Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair, and said daily gasoline demand rose from 33 million liters to 38 million liters, an increase of 5 million liters a day. Gasoline shortages began several days ago, and current oil output exceeds 3 million barrels a day.

title: Iraq to Receive Gasoline Shipments to Ease Supply Shortage
